description: A team lead must resolve a strained handoff between Alex and Sam on a high-visibility client account, deciding the handoff owner, timing, communication safeguards, and mediation process.

shared_context.S1: Alex and Sam have had repeated disagreements about client communications on the Northstar account.
shared_context.S2: The disagreements have delayed two client responses and are affecting the team's working relationship.
shared_context.S3: Maya decides the account handoff and the immediate workplace-repair plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the team's routine escalation process, Maya asks Alex, Sam, and HR to state any relevant constraints or observations before finalizing the plan.

PF1.text: After the latest confrontational meeting, Alex experienced panic symptoms and told Maya's deputy that Alex can transfer Northstar ownership to Sam within exactly 5 business days, but needs all direct one-to-one meetings with Sam restricted for exactly 30 calendar days; Alex has not told Maya directly because the deputy said the matter would be included in the escalation review.

PF2.text: Sam has observed three recent handoff disputes in which decisions changed after verbal conversations, so Sam needs every Northstar handoff update to name a reviewer and be recorded in a written status note twice each week; Sam has not added this request to the account plan yet.

PF3.text: Renee confirmed in a policy review this week that a conflict case involving repeated confrontational meetings requires separate check-ins with each employee before any joint mediation, and that HR must document the repair plan within exactly 3 business days; the confirmation is not yet in Maya's case packet.

acceptance_conditions: Sam must become the Northstar account owner.
The handoff must be completed within exactly 5 business days.
Direct one-to-one meetings between Alex and Sam must be restricted for exactly 30 calendar days.
Every Northstar handoff update must require a named reviewer and written status notes twice each week.
Separate check-ins must occur before any joint mediation.
HR must document the repair plan within exactly 3 business days.

decisive_facts.why: Alex's stated agreement makes Sam the handoff owner, fixes the deadline at exactly 5 business days, and changes the interpersonal safeguard to exactly 30 days without direct one-to-one meetings.
Sam's three observed disputes change the communication plan from informal discussion to a named reviewer plus written status notes twice each week.
The confirmed HR policy changes the process to separate check-ins before joint mediation and sets the repair-plan documentation deadline at exactly 3 business days.
